description: Video Studio verbs for an existing clip, on the same engines the studio uses. verb=change restyles or edits a clip (prompt + video_url, optional reference images). verb=move puts a character image into a driving video's motion (video_url + image_url + video_duration). verb=extend continues a clip forward, or backward on the default engine (prompt + video_url, optional duration and direction). Omit `model` for the studio default; engine-specific settings go in `params` with an explicit `model`. To make a new video, use pixeldojo_generate. Returns asset URLs, or a jobId for pixeldojo_status when the job outlasts the 30s wait. Local files: video_path / image_path (uploaded to 24h temp storage first).

direction.description: Extend only. backward adds footage before the clip; only the default engine supports it.

duration.description: Extend only: output length in seconds (default engine 4-30, wan-2.7-i2v 2-15 total), or seconds added on grok-video-extend (2-10). Ignored by change and move, which keep the source length.

image_path.description: Absolute local path to the character or reference image. Uploaded to 24h temp storage and used as image_url.

image_url.description: The character image (move, required) or a reference image (change, optional; some engines take none).

image_urls.description: More reference images for change engines that take a set. Move uses the first image only.

model.description: Video Studio engine for this verb. Omit for the default. change: seedance-2-5-video-edit, flux-video-edit, kling-video-edit, wan-video-edit, seedance-video-edit, happyhorse-1.0-video-edit, xai-video-edit (default seedance-2-5-video-edit); move: kling-motion-control, wan-video-character-swap (default kling-motion-control); extend: seedance-2-5-video-edit, wan-2.7-i2v, grok-video-extend (default seedance-2-5-video-edit). A model not on the verb's list is replaced by the default and the result says so.

params.description: Advanced settings for the model that runs this, named exactly as that model documents them (e.g. {"resolution": "1080p", "seed": 42}). Set `model` in the same call: field names differ per model, so params without one are refused. Applied last, so these override anything derived from the other inputs. An invalid field comes back named with its allowed values and nothing is charged, so fix it and call again.

prompt.description: What to change, how the character should move, or what happens next. Required for change and extend. Optional for move (wan-video-character-swap ignores it). @Name uses a character or element the user saved in Character Studio (photos attached automatically).

verb.description: change = restyle or edit an existing clip; move = put a character image into a driving video (motion transfer / character swap); extend = continue a clip forward (or backward on the default engine).

video_duration.description: The source clip's length in seconds. Required by every engine except the change/extend default and grok-video-extend, since it sets their credit cost.

video_path.description: Absolute local path to the source clip (MP4, WebM, MOV). Uploaded to 24h temp storage and used as video_url.

video_url.description: The source clip (change, extend) or the driving motion clip (move). Required.

name: pixeldojo_video
title: Change, animate or extend video
